color.note: Every text colour meets 4.5:1 on the grounds its note names in Light and Dark, and 7:1 in High contrast; control borders, icons, chart series and the focus ring meet 3:1 (High contrast: 3:1 too, with heavier strokes). Status is never shown by colour alone: every status also has a word or icon.

tokens.name: bg-document
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything.

tokens.name: bg-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, dialogs, table rows, form controls.

tokens.name: bg-subtle
tokens.usage: Sunken areas: table header, zebra rows, the bottom bar, disabled fields.

tokens.name: text-default
tokens.usage: Body copy and headings on bg-document, bg-surface and bg-subtle.

tokens.name: text-subtle
tokens.usage: Hints, captions, secondary amounts on bg-document, bg-surface and bg-subtle. Never for anything a user must read to act.

tokens.name: border-default
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and card outlines only; carries no meaning.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Borders of text boxes, selects, checkboxes and other controls; at least 3:1 on bg-surface and bg-document.

tokens.name: action-1
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, links, selected navigation item, checked controls. As text on bg-surface and bg-document.

tokens.name: action-1-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of action-1 fills and links.

tokens.name: on-action-1
tokens.usage: Text and icons on action-1 and action-1-hover fills.

tokens.name: accent-2
tokens.usage: Kunyit (turmeric) accent: budget meter, highlighted totals, chart series 2 as text. Text on bg-surface and accent-2-bg.

tokens.name: accent-2-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind highlighted totals and the "needs attention" panel; text-default and accent-2 read on it.

tokens.name: status-positive
tokens.usage: Positive status text and icons (active, paid, under budget) on status-positive-bg and bg-surface.

tokens.name: status-positive-bg
tokens.usage: Background of positive alerts and badges.

tokens.name: status-negative
tokens.usage: Error text, error icons and the error border of invalid fields, on status-negative-bg and bg-surface.

tokens.name: status-negative-bg
tokens.usage: Background of error alerts, the error summary and negative badges.

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons (trial ending, cancel-by date near) on status-warning-bg.

tokens.name: status-warning-bg
tokens.usage: Background of warning alerts and badges.

tokens.name: status-info
tokens.usage: Informational text and icons on status-info-bg.

tokens.name: status-info-bg
tokens.usage: Background of informational alerts and badges.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The focus outline: 3px solid, 2px outside the element, over the page ground; at least 3:1 on bg-document and bg-surface.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 (largest category); at least 3:1 on bg-surface. Always paired with a label or pattern, never colour alone.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4.

families.sans: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", "Atkinson Hyperlegible", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: One per page, the page title; receives focus after navigation.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Groups inside a section, card titles.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text. 18px, as on Dutch government sites; never smaller for running text.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body text, subscription names in lists.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, table headers, button text.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Hints, captions, secondary details. The smallest size in the app.

styles.name: amount-large
styles.usage: The headline totals on the dashboard. Use with tabular figures.

styles.name: amount
styles.usage: Amounts in lists and tables, right-aligned, tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its control; inside badges.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of buttons and controls.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; gap between form fields; the page side gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding from tablet up; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Space above a page heading; page side gutter on wide screens.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, checkboxes, the focus outline.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, text boxes, selects, alerts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, the dashboard totals panel.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Logo discs and the avatar of a household member.

size.note: Fixed sizes that carry accessibility rules.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of every button, link area and control on touch (WCAG 2.5.8 asks 24px; Abonemen uses 44px).

tokens.name: focus-width
tokens.usage: Width of the focus outline.

tokens.name: focus-offset
tokens.usage: Gap between an element and its focus outline.

tokens.name: border-width
tokens.usage: Dividers and card outlines.

tokens.name: border-width-control
tokens.usage: Control borders; 3px in the High contrast theme via the component CSS.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the page content column.

tokens.name: logo-size
tokens.usage: Subscription logo disc in lists; 56px on the detail page.

shadow.note: Borders, not shadows: one shadow, for things that float above the page.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialogs and menus only. High contrast uses a 2px border instead.
